# Links to Nowhere in Particular

An inline link to [the example site](https://example.org/ "Example title")
and an autolink <https://example.org/a/path/that/goes/on/for/quite/a/while/before/it/finally/stops/somewhere.html>
appear in one paragraph.

A reference link to [the field guide][guide] and a collapsed one to
[Guide][] use definitions given below.

Emphasis around a link: *see [the index](https://example.org/index)*, and
**strong text with [a link](https://example.org/strong)** inside it.

[guide]: https://example.org/field-guide
[Guide]: https://example.org/guide
